source_record.title: Training Coordinator / Trainer
source_record.description:
Your missions

Training

  • Design, prepare, deliver and update theoretical and practical technical training courses in the aeronautical field, according to operational needs.
  • Develop and update training content and teaching materials based on identified needs and the different skill levels of participants.
  • Transfer the technical knowledge and know-how required to perform aeronautical activities.
  • Organise and monitor participants’ progress, assess learning outcomes and propose areas for improvement.
  • Support participants in developing their skills and ensure appropriate follow-up in line with training objectives.

Equipment and workshop management

  • Ensure that the training center and workshops are clean, tidy and in good condition.
  • Check the availability of equipment and consumables required for training activities and place orders if necessary.
  • Immediately report any anomaly, safety issue or shortage of equipment to management.

Health and safety

  • Ensure compliance with health and safety rules in workshops and training areas.
  • Ensure that participants wear the required personal protective equipment.
  • Report any incident or accident to management without delay.

Administrative management and organisation

  • Keep attendance sheets and training follow-up documents up to date.
  • Participate in the preparation and updating of training schedules.
  • Ensure the administrative follow-up required for the proper running of training activities.
  • Secure the smooth implementation of training schedules
  • Prepare a detailed weekly report to be validated with the line manager, and actively participate in the preparation and coordination of the monthly pedagogical committee.


Your profile

  • Technical training in the aeronautical field.
  • At least 3 years of professional experience in the trade and/or experience as a team leader.
  • Good command of technical and teaching practices.
  • Strong organisational skills, accuracy and autonomy.
  • Good interpersonal skills, ability to transfer knowledge and support participants.
  • Strong awareness of safety, quality and cleanliness requirements.
  • Fluency in German, French and English.
  • Availability to travel regularly to Toulouse.
